text:
you set it up with a 6 volt battery, just two wires when you connect them and it ignites. Captain Kennedy, he was from Boston, his mom sent him a telescope, I don't think it was mounted. At the bottom of the hill is a crossroad of the Ho Chi Min trail. We fired it and we hit it.

Major Schwartzkoff, I had been asking to go out on patrol, he said Hunnewell you can go with us, go to armory and get a weapon, so I go up there and I don't know what to get and grab a pistol 45 automatic and come running back down with it and he said I don't want anybody taking a pistol out in the jungle. If you go out there with that pistol you are unarmed are going to do. So I got a BAR Browning Automatic Rifle. They weight about 22 pounds. The major was a character. Real nice guy.
